reason: A deals head-on with the four-month report chase: it explains why the report was late, names Dave Lin as responsible, sets a 30-day deadline and offers quarterly fresh-food totals. Its numbers are honest (about 12% more fresh food a year, not double), and it states the $4,500 yearly running cost. B is full of unfilled placeholders, leaves the reporting fix vague and skips operating costs, so it would only make me more worried.
